title: Plentiful Paths
description: This mod adds a bunch of vanilla-friendly path blocks which are all craftable!
body:
Welcome to Plentiful Paths! This is a mod about adding all the paths your feeble mind can think of! I hope you enjoy!

Plentiful Paths is my third mod and I hope you enjoy it!

This is a mod for all the builders out there. There is practically every color and shade of path you can think of, from the brightest orange to a more dull brown, this mod has got it all!

This mod will probably have very few versions until Mojang updates the documentation for updating to 1.21.5 Forge, or unless the mod needs some bugfixes.

 

Stay tuned, because there will be more! I plan to make the "Plentiful" thing a series of mods for the building community.

--Originally Uploaded To CurseForge--
